name: Cholera & mosquito-borne
value: Cholera in DRC; record dengue seasons
summary: Cholera spreading in DR Congo and CAR; record dengue outbreaks
state: UN agencies report cholera cases rising in DR Congo alongside the Ebola response, and the Central African Republic has declared a cholera outbreak (October). Florida's dengue outbreak is the largest in a US state in decades. No WHO grade 3 declaration as of 3 Nov.
for_you: Follow NHS Fit for Travel advice on mosquito bites and safe water.

sources.title: UN News — Cholera in DR Congo
Medical Xpress — Florida dengue outbreak largest in decades

why: Climate-sensitive diseases — cholera, dengue, chikungunya, Oropouche, West Nile and yellow fever — are hitting record levels and reaching new regions.
drivers: Conflict, floods, heat, El Niño, water and sanitation, mosquito range expansion.

rubric.alert: Large outbreaks with high mortality in conflict zones, or a WHO grade 3 emergency.
rubric.watch: Record-level seasons, or local transmission in countries where the disease was not established (including Europe).
